none

## Forward-carry

- `tools/audit/seat/mutant_run.py` judges a same-size mutant against the previous mutant's bytecode. It sets `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`, but a command run as `python3 -I` ignores every `PYTHON*` variable and writes `__pycache__` for each mutant; two consecutive mutants of equal length applied within one second share the source mtime and size the `.pyc` is validated on, so the second runs the first's code. Measured at 686f63af with a two-entry `--spec` over `finder_overlap.py` (`TWIN_FROM` 71 to 72, `sys.path.insert` 0 to 1) under `--cmd "python3 -I tools/audit/seat/finder_overlap.py --self-test --no-mutants" --copy-tree`: together both print `KILLED`; each alone prints `KILLED twin ids` and `SURVIVED path pos`, the null control showing the verdicts trade places. A repair is to remove `__pycache__` or set `sys.dont_write_bytecode` in the measured command's own interpreter, or to run each mutant with `-B`; not built here, outside this group's files. pull.body:
R11-OUTSIDE-CONTRIBUTOR-CYCLE-P3, part 1 of 2 (topic r11-outside-contributor-cycle-p3): the outside contract (decision 0017, `tools/pr/outside.py`) is asked on every path that merges a fork head, and only from origin/main's copy.

Carry 4 (merge_pr.sh app mode merged a cross-repository head without the contract): `gates` now reads whose head it is in both modes; app mode on a fork head merges only where outside.py's `check` at origin/main admits that exact head (`outside_contract`), its refusal printed before anything posts. Carry 5 (`Train.fork_head` executed the checkout's outside.py before comparing it): `fork_head` calls `outside_is_mains((OUTSIDE_PATH,))` before the read, so a stale copy answering "ours" stops there. Carry 6 (`Train.land` asked the contract only when the base is main): a fork head is put to `outside_contract` on a `batch/` base too, where the contract's base rule refuses it. Step 8's sibling seam, built: merge_pr.sh executed its checkout's outside.py uncompared as well, and now applies the train's rule, reading the train's `OUTSIDE_MAIN_COPIES` (no second list). Carry 0 (the interface between the parts): part 2 landed after part 1 and already calls the real `pull_facts`, `cross_repository` and `check`, driven by the train's "the real outside.py" cases; this part adds merge_pr.sh's pin binding each call it makes on the real module, and re-ran the three self-tests (Figures). Carry 1: `tools/ci/selftest_closures.json` re-recorded for merge-train, pr-merger and outside-contract. Carry 3: the four instrument guides carry `--head-repo`, the `[OUTSIDE]` class, the fork-head fetch sentence and this part's merge paths; decision 0017's text is the owner's and is not edited here. Carry 2, the live checks on a test fork, is not run: Forward-carry.

Alternatives: merge_pr.sh could refuse every fork head and route it to the train (decision 0017 gives the merge to the train), which removes its contract call; not taken, because this part's brief names merge_pr.sh app mode as a path that asks the contract. Comparing only outside.py before the contract in merge_pr.sh would leave the contract's other program inputs (policy_lint.mjs's policy set, closure.py's gate files, the mandate gate) a stale checkout's, which the train refuses; the train's list is read instead.

## Head

A renamed `check` (`sed 's/^def check(/def check_renamed(/'` on a copy) makes the signature pin's own read exit 1 (`AttributeError: module 'outside' has no attribute 'check'`).

pull.body:
R11-PRE-SHARED-FILES part 1, union half (`dev/programme/triage/r10-round-end.md` P748, P762; tvofi card C6, 2026-11-15). `record` in `tools/ci/selftest_scope.py` unions every measurement over the committed entry (`union_record` over `union_entry`, the same union `check --write` writes for main's artifact), so a re-record at a stale base no longer drops reads main measures (#3409, #3419, #3506). A read leaves the table only by `prune --step ID --drop KIND:ITEM`. The table `tools/ci/selftest_closures.json` is recorded here as that union over main's own measurement, which turns main's red drift step green.

## Re-cut

Fifth-round body, replaced. Round history is dropped; every figure below is taken at the head named. The re-cut follows P762 and roster carry 9: the table-shrink guard is dropped (`shrink_drops`, `table_base`, `shrink_gaps`, its `static` hook, its fixtures and mutants). The self-test's environment hold and the `main` return-type wrapper go too, because only the guard's base selectors needed them. The union record, `prune` and their tests stay.

Blocking verdict at `00a470f7b7` (`mutation-vacuous`), each finding answered:

- **M3**: `shrink_gaps`'s deletion exemption widened from status D to every touched path survived. Answer: `shrink_gaps` is deleted with the guard (P762), so the predicate no longer exists. `git grep -n 'shrink_gaps\|shrink_drops' -- tools/` prints nothing at this head.
- **M1**: `table_base`'s merge-base replaced by a bare `rev-parse` survived. Answer: `table_base` is deleted with the guard. `git grep -n table_base -- tools/` prints nothing at this head.

The verdict also lists the reviewer's own killed mutants. Two of their predicates stay: the gated-step filter of `union_record` and `prune`'s held-item checks. Both are now pinned by in-tree mutants (below). The third, the probe-is-a-file filter in `union_entry`, is removed as a defect (next paragraph).

Found in this pass and fixed here: `union_entry` dropped a probe that the union also held as a file. `drift` answers a measured probe from `probes` alone, so that union made the next drift run refuse it. Replaying main's measurement against a table written with the filter refused `tools/audit/round4/**` in `open-pr`, `pr-args` and `update-pr`, 3 refusals. Without the filter there are 0. The union is now pure. The `union_record` check expects the probe kept, and it fails on the filtered copy (`FAIL union_record: recording one step over an entry holding reads the trace lacks keeps them`).

## Head

`d95a2bc761b7ce0fb14f3ff4e239a8d045567557` merges the authored code head `8ccc59556f257b52e65c0e364957cf86c9d018c7`.

`8ccc59556f257b52e65c0e364957cf86c9d018c7`, measured 2026-11-15 between 13:30Z and 13:50Z against `origin/main` `b3831ff64eca1936f0b618193ee86c3e337b51a9`. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` conflicted in `tools/ci/selftest_closures.json` after the table union was committed on the old head. So `origin/main` was merged in (`5dccb958d6`), and the table was resolved as `union_record` over main's table of the branch's table and main's artifact.

## Mutation proof

`sh tools/ci/selftest_scope_mutants.sh` at this head: 27 mutants, ends `SELFTEST-SCOPE MUTANTS: every mutant refused`, no `NOT REFUSED`, `MUTANT NOT APPLIED` or `BASELINE RED` line. The union-half mutants and the check each one fails:

- "record replaces the committed entry again" (`entries[sid] = m`): FAIL `union_record: recording one step over an entry holding reads the trace lacks keeps them`. This is the failing test first: the replace semantics `record` had at the merge base.
- "record keeps a step the workflow no longer gates": FAIL `union_record: a step not re-measured is kept, a step the workflow no longer gates is not`.
- "the union drops a committed list entry", "the union drops a committed flag": FAIL `check --write: a planted committed read and flag the run did not measure survive the write`.
- "prune clears a flag the entry does not set", "prune drops a list item the entry does not hold": FAIL `prune_entries: a read the entry does not hold is reported, not ignored`.
- "prune writes nothing", "prune accepts an unknown drop", "prune goes on over an unreadable table": each fails its `prune:` CLI check.

## Null control

- Drift replay with main's own table at this head's tree: the same 4 refusals main's CI printed (below), so the replay reads what CI reads. Replaying with the artifact itself as the table gives 0 refusals.
- Dropped reads: comparing every step of `origin/main`'s table with this head's, item by item and flag by flag, gives `117 step(s) compared, 0 dropped read(s)`. Of the 17 `-` lines of `git diff origin/main -- tools/ci/selftest_closures.json`, 13 are duplicate `D/**` items that `union_entry`'s set removes (main's table holds 13 duplicates, counted per step and kind as list length less set size). The other 4 are values that grew: `[]` now filled, `false` now `true`. The same comparison against a copy with one `open-pr` file removed prints `DROP open-pr files tools/site/day_chart.mjs`, `1 dropped read(s)`.
- `python3 -I tools/ci/selftest_scope.py --self-test` prints `118 checks, 0 failed` both unset and with `GITHUB_BASE_REF=main` exported.

## Figures

- Main's red step: `governance / instrument-self-tests`, step `selftest_scope.py check --traces ... --write` (the drift step, run only on a push to main). Main CI run 43705258717 at `26dbf7c43e` and run 43716462808 at `b3831ff64e` both print `selftest_scope check: 117 gated step(s), 4 refusal(s)`, from `UNDER-SCOPED step verdict-bus: files misses ['.github/workflows/ci.yml']`, `orchestrator-tick: probes misses ['.gitmodules']`, `orchestrator-tick: it read the index`, `merge-train: files misses ['tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs', 'tools/pr/outside.py']`.
- That step's predicate, replayed offline. The trace needs Linux strace, so the measurement is each run's `selftest-closures` artifact, which is `union_entries(main's table, measured)` and so holds every read main measured. Command, with `A` the downloaded artifact and `T` the table: `python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; sys.path.insert(0,"tools/ci"); import selftest_scope as s; r,_=s.drift(json.load(open(sys.argv[2])), json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["steps"], s.workflow_steps(s.ROOT)); print(*r, sep="\n"); print(len(r), "refusal(s)")' A T`. At `origin/main`'s table: `4 refusal(s)`, the four lines above, for both artifacts. At this head's table: `0 refusal(s)` for both artifacts. So the merge turns the drift step green on main's current measurement.
- Limit: the replay uses main's measurement and does not trace this head. This head changes the reads of one gated step only, `selftest-scope` (its self-test). Its new fixtures run in a scratch repository outside the checkout, and its table entry keeps every read the branch recorded. A new in-tree read would show as UNDER-SCOPED in the first main run after the merge.
- `python3 -I tools/ci/selftest_scope.py static`: `117 gated step(s), 0 problem(s)`.
- `python3 -I tools/ci/selftest_scope.py --self-test`: `118 checks, 0 failed`.

## Brief carries

The group's ten roster carries (`git show origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json`, group R10-SELFTEST-SCOPE-UNION-GUARD, by array position):

- Carry 9 (the re-cut): done. The guard, its fixtures and its mutants are dropped, and the union record is kept with its failing test and mutant. Roster stage `absorbed` into R11-PRE-SHARED-FILES once this merges (the orchestrator's op).

This diff does not touch `tests/features.py`. Fixed on main by #3578 (R10-HOTFIX-FEATURES-WEEKEND-CLOCK), which is in this head's ancestry. At this head, before CI: none. Main's inherited red, `governance / instrument-self-tests` (the drift step, on push to main only), is the step this merge turns green (Figures). pull.title: record: round 10 objective record under decision 0018
pull.body:
Round 10's objective record, which decision 0018 section 6 has the closing round write and which round 10's close did not write, written now under tvofi's ruling on card E11-N-OBJECTIVE-RECORD ("Write it now (Recommended)"). The record is `dev/audit/yardstick/round10/OBJECTIVE.json`, one row per term of `dev/audit/config/objective.json`. Its by-hand escapes ledger is `dev/audit/rounds/round10/objective/escapes_hand.tsv`; `escapes`, `injected` and `unowned` carry its counts as `by_hand` beside a NO-READ. The ledger sits under the round's directory, as the round-11 evaluation keeps its own under `dev/audit/rounds/round11/evaluation/`. The third change is one glob in `tests/layout.json`. No production, instrument or policy file changes, and nothing is closed by keyword.

## Summary

- **Window.** v7.0.0 (`9cb735dfc6`, 2026-10-14T13:27:06Z, subject `v7.0.0: stamp Round-9 closure`) to v10.0.0 (`13cbe48de4`, 2026-11-15T05:22:47Z): 0018 section 2 reads "from the previous closeout stamp to its own". That is 1210 first-parent commits, of which 1139 are merges.
- **Roster pin.** `dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json` at `c080e93403e69543564ee334f0772229a28331b3`, the tip of `handoff/audit-r10-roster` when read (548 groups). Every roster-derived command in the record names this sha. The builders named in the record (R11-INTAKE-R10-RESIDUE, R11-PRE-ROUND-METRICS, R11-PRE-TOKEN-LEDGER) are carry-receivable groups of the roster `check_scopes.py` reads at the ref.
- **Terms.** 1 of 13 has a value: `first_pass`, 0.5058 by `flow_metrics.py` and 0.5138 by `review_strength.py`. 0018 names both, and they count different populations, so the record carries both. The other 12 are `no_read`, each with `would_read` and `builder`. The table in 0018 section 2 gives `none` as the enumerator for `regret`, `operation`, `unowned`, `escapes`, `injected`, `coverage`, `unexamined`, `lead_time`, `closure_slip` and `tokens_per_change`. The examined count of `generality` has none either. `product_green`'s named enumerator prints `A_gate  unread (runs.json)`.
- **Escapes, by hand.** The matching rule, the two commands that print the 98 candidates, and the ruling classes are in the ledger's header. 26 escapes fall in the window: 15 from owner reports and 11 from outside reports. 6 more are owner reports dated the stamp's own day, 2026-10-14, which no tracked record gives an hour for (their issues were opened on 2026-10-15 by the orchestrator). 1 was caused and caught before a release (R10-HOTFIX-REFERENCE-BASIS). 65 candidates are ruled out, each with its reason. 7 escapes are owned by `none`, and that is `unowned.by_hand`. 4 bugs carry a named cause in the window, which gives `injected.by_hand` 2.58 per 100 over 155 production merges:
  - R10-SAVINGS-NEGATIVE: pull request 2411.
  - R10-HOTFIX-SAV-ESTIMATE: 2411 and 2887, both named by the tracked `dev/audit/rca/R10-RCA-SAV-ESTIMATE.md`.
  - R10-HOTFIX-FLOW-SETPOINT-STUCK: 3404.
  - R10-HOTFIX-REFERENCE-BASIS: 3587.

  The R10 records under `dev/audit/rca/` were searched for every `in` and `unreleased` group. `R10-RCA-COP-UNMEASURED.md` and `R10-RCA-COP-PARTLOAD.md` name causes from before both windows (pull request 50 in v4.0.0, and the v1.0.0 law), so they add none.
- **Where this differs from the revised evaluation (`eval/r11` 7891b714f8, a lead, never copied).**
  - `escapes`: 26 against 30. The evaluation counts four rows this ledger rules out. R10-BUFFER-STORE, R10-LEARNED-STORE-LOAD and R10-COP-GATE-E were found by fixer seats. Such a report is neither a judged finding nor an outside report, so it is no objective bug by 0018 section 2's definition. R10-OUTSIDE-SUPPLY-MIN-RUN-PAUSE is classed `NEED` by its own feature triage.
  - Stamp-day rows: 6 against 8 at `eval-review/r11-3` 92991d2a49. The evaluation adds R10-UX-SETUP, which this ledger rules a redesign, and R10-SAV-ACTUATION, which it rules a feature. No stamp-day row counts in any term.
  - R10-MIN-POWER-FLOOR is owned by D2 here and by D8 in the evaluation. The plan stepped outside the pump's own limits, below `heat_pump_min_power` and above `p_max` (pull request 3308's body). That breaks D2's operating-grid identity. D8 owns a published value, and the fix changed the plan, not only the slot attribute. The difference moves no term's value.
  - `injected`: its denominator is 155 production merges. The evaluation's 162 comes from `machinery_ratchet.py --window 1210`, but that flag counts merges, and the window holds 1139 of them. 1210 reaches 71 merges into round 9.
  - `unowned`: 7 against 8. R10-HOTFIX-FLOW-SETPOINT-STUCK is owned by D1, following the evaluation review's R6.
  - `first_pass` matches the evaluation to the rounding.
- **What `check_scopes.py --round 11` prints.**
  - On this branch alone: 1 gap, `dev/audit/yardstick/round11/EVALUATION.json is not in the tree`.
  - On a throwaway merge of this tip with `eval/r11` 7891b714f8: 48 gaps, 47 `card ... carries no owner decision` and 1 `review is not an approve verdict`.
  - The same evaluation without this record: 49 gaps, the extra one being `dev/audit/yardstick/round10/OBJECTIVE.json is not in the tree`. This record removes that gap and adds none.
- **Not followed as written.** 0018 section 5 says "The orchestrator writes two things and no others: a closing round's objective record, once", and section 6 says the record is one "which the orchestrator writes at closure". This record is written after the close, by a record seat working for the round-11 orchestrator. The orchestrator publishes it, and tvofi's approving review makes it his.
- **Self-test repair.** The first head, f460c3a2, put the ledger under `dev/audit/yardstick/round10/`. `check_scopes.py --self-test`'s yardstick arm requires the unclassified files there to be exactly the two planted round records, so `governance / instrument-self-tests` went red. The ledger now lives under the round's directory, and `check_scopes.py` is unchanged.
- **Layout.** `tests/layout.json` gains `dev/audit/yardstick/**` in its `dev/audit` category. Without it, prepr's CI predict printed `PREDICT tests / fast (3.14) LAYOUT placement: dev/audit/yardstick/round10/OBJECTIVE.json is in 0 categories of tests/layout.json` and the same for the ledger. `eval/r11`'s `round11/EVALUATION.json` sits under the same directory and needs the same line. `119b5cb851be6620c19cb16c69ff9391be7ea0b5`. It sits on the pull request's previous head f460c3a2b3, which is 7f0a55487c plus the delivery row. pull.title: R11-HOTFIX-SELFTEST-FLAKE-ARMS: r11 hotfix selftest flake arms
pull.body:
Closes the R11-HOTFIX-SELFTEST-FLAKE-ARMS group (triage dev/programme/triage/r10-round-end.md#P782; root cause dev/audit/rca/R10-RCA-FAMILY-FLAKY-SELFTEST.md, state (c)). Two self-test arms asserted an ordering between concurrent processes with no barrier. Both are now ordered by explicit barriers. The third instance (carry 167, tests/entities.py redaction check) is already fixed on main by f38124f19c, which compares two clock-free payloads; nothing is changed there.

Alternatives that lost: retrying a red self-test once (refused in the RCA: hides a real intermittent defect, costs a job per red); an injected clock in beatd (the race is job ordering, not time). The one production line added to `bus.sh` confirm() touches `HPO_BUS_WAIT_MARK` only when set, so the arm can see the second confirm waiting on a live holder.

## Head

`62abeb4849dbb7443240fd9d879d970ff2f98780` is this PR's head, unchanged: its code was already in it and main merged cleanly, so the orchestrator's script set this body without a push.

2bbfb7f3553b34732b515c92b2679fa2b64f23a2, measured 2026-11-15 13:21Z; origin/main tip at that time b3831ff64eca1936f0b618193ee86c3e337b51a9.

## Mutation proof

Predicate mutated in place, then restored: in `bus.sh` confirm() the lock acquisition `until mkdir "$lk" 2>/dev/null; do` replaced by `mkdir -p "$lk"; until true; do`. `bash tools/audit/seat/bus.sh --self-test` then reports FAIL for: "a confirm under a live holder's lock waits and moves nothing (P354)", "two concurrent confirms produce one verdict commit and one post (P354)", "a lock whose pid is not yet written is a live holder inside the settle (P354)" (3 failed). beatd: `python3 -I tools/audit/seat/beatd.py --self-test 9` reports "mutant m9_running_ignored turns (9) 'a running instance defers the restart to the next pass' red".

## Null control

Unmodified head: `bus.sh --self-test` 239 checks, 0 failed, including both existing P354 null controls (dead holder's lock taken over; empty pid past the settle taken over). `beatd.py --self-test 9`: 34 checks, 0 failed, including "null: with no restart taken the same job runs" and "null: behind only off the seat paths does not restart".

## Figures

- Instrument: 12 concurrent `python3 -I tools/audit/seat/beatd.py --self-test 9 --no-mutants` on one 4-core host with 6 CPU burners, counting runs with any FAIL line, `grep -l FAIL`. Base (origin/main beatd.py): 1 of 12 runs failed, the arm "a running instance defers the restart to the next pass". Head: 0 of 12. A single 12-run sample; the base rate is not established by it.
- Instrument: 8 concurrent `bus.sh --self-test` with 4 CPU burners, counting the P354 arm's result lines with `grep -h P354 | sort | uniq -c`. Head: the concurrent-confirm arm ok in 8 of 8. The base run of the same shape showed the arm ok too (0 failures of it in 8), so the base failure was not reproduced by this load; the arm's non-race is argued by construction (the second confirm now starts only after the first holds the lock inside the poster, and the gate opens only after the second is seen waiting), and its detection is shown by the mutation above.
- Unrelated reds seen under that 8x load, not owed here: base run, "a failed check-runs read is reported on a line, not swallowed (P344)" 4 times and "null control: no autofix job at all dispatches (P344)" once; head run, "a ref whose file main already carries under a moved path is SUPERSEDED" once. They are other timing-dependent arms of the same self-test under oversubscription.
- Gate scope: `python3 tests/closure.py select --diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)` printed `MODE: SCOPED`, scope tests/doc_claims.py; `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/doc_claims.py` ALL 410 checks PASSED. `python3 tests/structure.py` RATCHET PASSED.

## Red checks

none

## Forward-carry

Carry 0 (tests/entities.py redaction check, wall-clock dependent) is discharged without a change in this diff: f38124f19c is on origin/main. Its control is in the tree: `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/entities.py` reports ok for "the location is redacted whole, from data and from options, not coarsened", for "the rounded-coordinate search ignores a clock reading that contains one" (a poisoned clock reading that holds a rounded coordinate hits the whole-blob search and not the clock-free one) and for "a genuinely coarsened coordinate in the payload still fails the clock-free search". The check pins its own clocks, so the wall clock cannot reach it. Carry: dismissed: already repaired on main by f38124f19c

pull.body:
Round-11 record: the round-10 round-end proposal triage, as `proposal-triage.md` (on main since #3451) shapes it: one consolidated batch, ruled once per instrument, over three inputs together (tvofi, 2026-11-15: "it should triage all its instrument groups together with your proposals and local prototypes before starting instrument work, some might be unnecessary"), plus one root-cause record per tooling-friction family (loop card L8). tvofi ruled every decision card the batch raised on 2026-11-15; the rulings are recorded in the entries. It adds record files only and closes nothing by keyword.

## Summary

- **The batch.** `dev/programme/triage/r10-round-end.md`, entries P742-P795 (54). pull.title: R10-COP-LEARNER-DRAW-FLOOR: r10 cop learner draw floor
pull.body:
R10-COP-LEARNER-DRAW-FLOOR, built on the approved design (`design.md` at 94d2c9f06576693b31996d21d18af241d41640b2 of design/R10-COP-LEARNER-DRAW-FLOOR; `Design review: approve`, design-verdict at 732212c268). Three carries on the COP learner's one judgement seam, `MeasuredCop` in `accuracy.py`. `Carry N` below is entry N (0-based) of this group's `carry` list on handoff/audit-r10-roster at 30097de04722.

What ships, by carry:

- **Carry 0 (84e73ec4), the capped floor.** `draw_range.power_floor_kw(draw, params)` is the one floor `MeasuredCop.judge_floor`, `coordinator._fold_flow_lift` and `accuracy.diagnostics_view` read, each on the same window object. It is `flow_lift_power_floor_kw` capped by the low end (`LOW_PERCENTILE`) of the draws metered under a run ask, never under `on_threshold_kw`. A run ask is an ask at or above the window's configured minimum and above zero: `DrawRange._run_asked`, the pair reader `follows_ask` built inline and now shares. Invariants (a) to (f) of the design are each a check in `tests/features.py`.
- **Carry 1 (35931f4b), hold-then-replay.** `draw_range.ask_evidence` returns one of four states; `follows_ask` is that state as a tri-state, results unchanged. `MeasuredCop.judge_ratio` is an instance method on the interval's row (`accuracy.CopInterval`): a departure beyond `COP_ASK_TOLERANCE` is held while the evidence is pending and reads `COP_REFUSED_NO_EVIDENCE`, no new code. `MeasuredCop.release` is the one place a held row is judged: all fold on follows, none on does-not-follow, base's rule where the evidence is unobtainable, and while it is pending base's rule for a row older than `COP_HOLD_HORIZON_S` (a week) or pushed out of a hold of `draw_range.WINDOW` rows. A released row folds against the scale it was read at. `diagnostics_view` gains `held_intervals`.
- **Carry 2 (R10-COP-GATE-E band), measurement, no build.** Re-run at this head, `dev/audit/harnesses/r10_cop_gate_band.py` reads `fit=none` on both fixtures under `tests/replay/` and its `--synthetic` control fits. The carry stays open on the named owner data (`## Forward-carry`).
- **Carry 3 (issue 3106 item 4, the set-point-to-draw map), not built here.** It is the brief of R10-DRAW-MAP-EVIDENCE, a live group ordered after this one and built on this handoff; nothing in this diff touches `thermal_model.flow_setpoint_for_level` or `follows_ask`'s slope test. Carry: R10-DRAW-MAP-EVIDENCE
- **Carries 4 to 9 are this body's own items, routed back to this group for a ruling**, each still under `## Forward-carry` or `## Friction` with its text unchanged: Carry 4 (09c5aa75, departure 1), Carry 5 (5b2b2810, departure 2), Carry 6 (ade1b168, note n2), Carry 7 (870278d1, the unobtainable arm), Carry 8 (28d8e538, the cap reads run-asked draws only), Carry 9 (b4659e0c, the `fixer.md` contradiction). None is built in this round: each waits on the owner's or the orchestrator's decision.
- The walking metered/asked ratio moved from the coordinator to `MeasuredCop.walk_ratio` (design note n1), which pays for the coordinator lines the release adds.

**Departures from the design note, each made because the tree refused the note's letter. They are disclosed here for the reviewer and routed under `## Forward-carry` for a ruling.**

1. **Where the release runs.** The note calls `release` from `_learn_measured_cop`, after the interval's own refusal is written. There, the check "#1523 class check: every learner feeder in coordinator.py consults the freeze or carries a disposition" went red (`undispositioned ['_learn_measured_cop']`): a cycle the learners are frozen on would have moved the COP scale. The census accepts a disposition, but its key is the function name, and an entry for `_learn_measured_cop` would also excuse any later fold of present evidence written there (`fixer.md` step 14). So the route changed: the release runs in `_fold_measured_cop`, past the freeze gate and the missing-reading guard and ahead of the interval's own judgement. The census passes with no new disposition. Consequences: a frozen cycle and a cycle with no power reading release nothing, and the hold cannot grow on such a cycle either; released rows fold before the cycle's own interval, not after; the interval's code is still its own, because the replay's return value is discarded.
2. **A replay trains the scale alone.** The note folds each released row through `_fold_cop_evidence`. That function's tail feeds the capacity envelope from this cycle's `_measured_power`, `_commanded_power()` and outdoor bucket, none of which is the held interval's. A replay returns before that tail. Cost: a held departure asked at or above 0.95 of nameplate no longer feeds the envelope, which it did when base folded it at its own tick.
3. **The cap is keyed to the configured range.** `power_floor_kw` returns the configured figure while the window's `config` differs from the live parameters' range. The note's invariant (e) reverts the floor when `DrawRange.observe` clears the window, which is at the next running sample; until then the window's pairs were asked under the old minimum, and a raised minimum would read them as run asks. The check for (e) pins both.
4. **`thermal_model.py` is touched, docstrings only.** The note lists it as not touched and its note n3 asks for `flow_lift_power_floor_kw`'s reference to the judgement to be updated; that reference was false at the head, so two docstrings changed and no code.
5. **One harness row the note lists as a null moves.** `p4_follow_lag1tick` folds fewer intervals than at the base (`## Figures`). Its draw is the previous interval's ask, the window reads that as not following, and the departures base folded before the evidence are now held and dropped. That is carry 35931f4b's stated behaviour on a draw that does not follow its ask; the note's spike did not show the row.

One existing check changed its expectation: "with no draw evidence a departure folds only past the nameplate third ... folds on 4 kW, as base" asserted the base behaviour this carry removes. It now pins both arms: pending holds on 4 kW and on 14 kW, and with no window base's rule stands.

The save cadence of the thermal learning store reads `_cop_samples // 10` crossing, where it read `% 10 == 0`: a release folds several intervals in one cycle and can step over a multiple of ten.

## Head

`5723ce192e589a344de0ddb3b50929b19e90fec7` merges the authored code head `a472503fe19d7237d3701d9ac6b23e16bd0fb675`.

a472503fe19d7237d3701d9ac6b23e16bd0fb675, on merge base 0a1ef512f42cbf380049b11b096eb89c5a222ccc. Measured 2026-11-15 04:39 UTC. At that time origin/main is 2c69fb3560f23381193ab9e3d2a1632fe38d35ba, and `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` reports no conflict (rc 0), so main is not merged again; the train re-proves the head on the current main.

Round 3, a repair of the red `tests / mutation` at the pull request's head 5cf3425240ac (`## Red checks`). The head is the round-2 handoff 29b99b6f9f0e merged with 5cf3425240ac (merge 24d89a1b44, no conflict), which brings the bot's `ci: merge main` and `ci: pin killed mutants`, and two commits on that merge: `git diff --stat 24d89a1b44 HEAD` lists `tests/features.py` and two files under `tests/mutation_ledger/killed_by/`. No production line changed in this round: `git diff 24d89a1b44 HEAD -- custom_components` prints nothing. The merge moved the merge base from 9fdba3b8547f to 0a1ef512f42c, so the figures below that are a function of the merge base were re-taken at this head and say so; a figure still naming a round-1 or round-2 commit is that commit's measurement.

- The two sites the lane named alive: one killing check each, under `## Mutation proof`, "Round 3". Neither is triaged.
- Whose line `coordinator.py:962` is: this branch's. `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD -- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py` holds one hunk in `_fold_flow_lift`, `-    if commanded < params.flow_lift_power_floor_kw:` and `+    if commanded < draw_range.power_floor_kw(coord._accuracy.draw, params):`. The branch rewrote the right-hand operand (carry 0); the `<` the mutant moves is main's own, unchanged, at line 961 of the merge base.

Round 2 was a repair of `Fix review: blocked a827c3d985b2` (probe/revt-r10-cop-learner-draw-floor-9a909e3e at 67ef8a2fc9cb). One commit on a827c3d985, 29b99b6f9f: `git diff --stat a827c3d985 29b99b6f9f` lists `tests/features.py`, `dev/audit/harnesses/cop_duty_floor.py` and one docstring line of `custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/accuracy.py`. No production code line changed: `git diff a827c3d985 29b99b6f9f -- custom_components` is that one docstring line. What it answers:

- Block 1 and 2, and the third survivor the review lists under `## Findings` (the span close's window argument): one killing check each, under `## Mutation proof`, "Round 2".
- Block 3: four budget rows moved, not five (`## Figures`, "Gate and ratchets").
- Block 4: `MeasuredCop.release`'s docstring now says where it runs: ahead of a cycle's own judgement, never on a frozen or unread cycle.
- The review's first finding (an install that never asks at or above its configured minimum waits for a full window): its rows are in the harness and in `## Figures`, and the finding is under `## Forward-carry`.
- The review's note that the body names no enumeration rule: the rule and its output are in `## Figures`, "Sibling sites".

## Mutation proof

Failing test first: the block from `R.section("R10-COP-LEARNER-DRAW-FLOOR` to `R.section("R10-COP-GATE (#2262)` of `tests/features.py`, run by `tools/audit/seat/features_block.py` with its emitted prelude, on the base's production files stops at `ImportError: cannot import name 'CopInterval'`; on this head it prints `ALL 33 FEATURES BLOCK PASSED`.

Hand mutants, each applied alone to a detached worktree at db4395285f (the production code is the same at the head: `git diff db4395285f 29b99b6f9f -- custom_components` is one docstring line of `accuracy.py`, and the merge of round 3 brings main's own changes) and restored, driven by that block and by the block before it (from `# silence the learner. Synthetic numbers only.`). The unmutated tree fails no check. Every mutant fails at least one; the first failing check is named.

| mutant | failing check (first) |
|---|---|
| `power_floor_kw`: `min(floor, low_kw)` to `low_kw` | (a) the cap never raises the floor |
| `power_floor_kw`: the `max(on_threshold_kw, ...)` dropped | (b) the floor never goes under on_threshold_kw |
| `power_floor_kw`: every evidence sample in place of `_run_asked` | (d) a draw under an ask below the configured minimum never moves the floor |
| `power_floor_kw`: `cfg_min <= 0.0` guard dropped | (f) with no modulation floor configured the nameplate third stands uncapped |
| `power_floor_kw`: the config-key guard dropped | (e) a window keyed to another configured range caps nothing |
| `power_floor_kw`: `MIN_SAMPLES - 1` | (c) no window, an empty one, and one of 47 run-asked pairs |
| `_run_asked`: the configured-minimum half dropped | (d) |
| `ask_evidence`: no window reads pending | ask_evidence is unobtainable with no window |
| `ask_evidence`: a full window stays pending | ask_evidence is unobtainable ... on a full window |
| `ask_evidence`: `WINDOW - 1` | ask_evidence is unobtainable ... one sample short of full it is still pending |
| `ask_evidence`: flat asks read pending | ask_evidence is unobtainable ... on asks that never moved |
| `judge_ratio`: the pending arm deleted (base's rule) | a departure is held ... only while the evidence is pending |
| `judge_ratio`: held and folded | a departure is held, and reads as awaiting evidence |
| `judge_ratio`: unobtainable held too | a departure is held ... takes base's rule with nothing held where it is unobtainable |
| `release`: does-not-follow judged by base's rule | release: evidence empties the hold |
| `release`: follows judged by base's rule | release: evidence empties the hold |
| `release`: no week exit | release: while the evidence is pending a row waits a week and no longer |
| `release`: week bound exclusive | the same check, at 7 days exactly |
| `release`: a stamp ahead of the clock waits | release: a row stamped ahead of the clock |
| `release`: no push-out exit; push-out off by one | release: the hold is bounded at 336 rows |
| `release`: pushed-out and aged rows returned unjudged | release: while the evidence is pending ... both leave by base's rule |
| `release`: unobtainable folds everything | release: where the evidence is unobtainable |
| `release`: the hold not cleared | release: evidence empties the hold |
| `judge_floor`: reads no window | judge_floor reads the capped floor on the window it is handed |
| `diagnostics_view`: the configured floor; the held count at 0 | a 2.0 kW interval on a 3.0 kW minimum ...; the diagnostics count the held intervals |
| `walk_ratio`: returns the walked value | walk_ratio hands back the value before the interval |
| coordinator: no release | a released interval folds against the scale it was read at |
| coordinator: the release ahead of the freeze gate | a frozen cycle and one with no power reading release nothing |
| coordinator: replay at the live scale; `read_scale` ignored; the row stamped with scale 1.0 | a released interval folds against the scale it was read at |
| coordinator: a replay feeds the present-state tail | a replayed interval folds the scale and not the capacity envelope |
| coordinator: a replay does not count as a sample | a released interval folds against the scale it was read at |
| coordinator: the cycle's floor, the flow-lift floor, each reading no window | a 2.0 kW interval on a 3.0 kW minimum folds its COP and its flow lift |

That is 38 mutants (a row with a semicolon is one mutant per clause). Two more, the survivors prepr's own mutant step drew at 38c3c4bb4d, are killed by checks added in a827c3d985 and listed under `## Unpinned sites`.

The route change of departure 1: with the release in `_learn_measured_cop` (the tree of acf912282f, this branch's first commit) the scoped gate's `tests/features.py` printed `2 of 5616 FEATURE CHECKS FAILED`, the #1523 class check (`undispositioned ['_learn_measured_cop']`) and its null control; at the head both pass.

### Round 2: the review's three survivors

Each of the review's three surviving mutants (`ev/mutants.py` at the probe ref) was first reproduced at a827c3d985 and then run at 29b99b6f9f, by `python3 tools/audit/seat/mutant_run.py --spec <the three as {name, file, old, new}> --cmd <driver>` in its `git archive` copy. The driver runs three blocks of `tests/features.py` through `features_block.py`, each behind the prelude `--emit-prelude` derives from the tree it runs on: the two blocks above and the block from `R.section("R10-HEAT-METER: a delivered-heat counter` to `R.section("supply switch at step boundaries`, where the span close's checks are. Unmutated, a827c3d985 prints `ALL 33`, `ALL 34` and `ALL 77 FEATURES BLOCK PASSED` and 29b99b6f9f `ALL 35`, `ALL 34` and `ALL 78`. The driver's null mutant printed `SURVIVED NULL` in both runs. Each mutant, applied alone to an archive copy of 29b99b6f9f, fails exactly one check of the block that holds it, the one named.

| mutant | at a827c3d985 | at 29b99b6f9f | the check that fails |
|---|---|---|---|
| `judge_ratio`: `or state == ASK_FOLLOWS` deleted (`accuracy.py`) | SURVIVED | KILLED | once the meter shows the draw follows the ask, a departure under the nameplate third teaches |
| the replay's `row.reference` replaced by `self._cop_reference_curve()` (`coordinator.py`) | SURVIVED | KILLED | a released interval is judged against the curve of the cycle it was read on |
| the span close's `coord._accuracy.draw` argument dropped (`coordinator.py`) | SURVIVED | KILLED | the span close judges the duty floor capped by the stored running-draw window |

- The first check asks 2.0 kW drawing 2.6 on a 14 kW nameplate, under the 4.2 kW third, through `judge_ratio` and through `_learn_measured_cop`: it folds on a window that follows and is refused `awaiting_draw_evidence` with no window (the control, base's rule).
- The second check does not pin a folded scale, as the review asked, because the reference cannot move one: with no heat reading `flow_meter.cop_evidence` returns the scale times ask over draw whatever the modelled COP, so a held row replayed against another outdoor temperature or the hot-water curve folds to the same scale. What the reference decides is whether the row folds at all (`COP_REFUSED_BLENDED` for a reference with no curve). The check drives both directions through the cycle with the operating mode observed: an interval held on a space cycle and released by a cycle split evenly between space and hot water folds (the mutant refuses it), and one held on such a blended cycle and released by a space cycle trains nothing (the mutant folds it).
- The third survivor is the one the review dismissed as a no-op in every state the design names. It is not equivalent, so it has a check and no triage: an install that metered its pump running under an overstated minimum and then dropped its power entity keeps the window in the store, and its span close reads the capped floor. The check runs a 2.0 kW counter span on a 3.0 kW minimum with no power entity: it folds behind a window that metered the pump at 1.8 kW and is refused `duty_floor` behind an empty one. This is the design's "one window object" read at its third caller; design note v4 stated the empty-window case only.

### Round 3: the two bound survivors

`tests / mutation` at 5cf3425240ac named `accuracy.py:1004 CMP_BOUND` and `coordinator.py:962 CMP_BOUND` alive. Each line was mutated by `python3 tools/audit/seat/mutant_run.py --spec <the four below as {name, file, old, new}> --cmd <driver>` in its `git archive` copy, at 24d89a1b44 (the merge, before this round's checks) and at this head. The driver runs the block of `tests/features.py` from `R.section("R10-COP-LEARNER-DRAW-FLOOR` to `R.section("R10-COP-GATE (#2262)` through `features_block.py`, behind the prelude `--emit-prelude` derives from the tree it runs on. The driver's null mutant printed `SURVIVED NULL` in both runs; unmutated the block prints `ALL 35 FEATURES BLOCK PASSED` at 24d89a1b44 and `ALL 37` at this head. `accuracy.py:1004` holds three comparisons and the lane's line does not say which survived, so all three were run: two were already killed and are the control that the driver reaches the line.

| mutant | at 24d89a1b44 | at this head | the one check that fails at this head |
|---|---|---|---|
| `release`: `0.0 <= utc_elapsed_seconds(now, row.at)` to `0.0 <` (`accuracy.py`) | SURVIVED | KILLED | release: a row stamped at the clock itself is zero seconds old and waits; a microsecond ahead of the clock it leaves by base's rule |
| `release`: `i >= over` to `i > over` (`accuracy.py`) | KILLED | KILLED | release: the hold is bounded at 336 rows |
| `release`: `<= COP_HOLD_HORIZON_S` to `<` (`accuracy.py`) | KILLED | KILLED | release: while the evidence is pending a row waits a week and no longer |
| `_fold_flow_lift`: `commanded < draw_range.power_floor_kw(...)` to `<=` (`coordinator.py`) | SURVIVED | KILLED | the flow-lift fold takes an ask exactly at the floor and refuses one a nanowatt under it, on the window's cap (1.8 kW) and on the configured figure (2.4 kW) |

- Neither survivor is equivalent, so each has a check and no triage. Age zero is reachable: a held row released on the instant it was stamped (a replayed cycle, a clock that did not advance) has a known age of 0 s; under the mutant it leaves the hold by base's rule, where the design holds it. An ask exactly at the floor is reachable where the plan asks the configured minimum on an install with no run-asked evidence.
- The flow-lift check reads its floor from `draw_range.power_floor_kw` itself and sets the ask to that double and to that double less 1e-9 kW, at both ends of the floor's range: the window's cap and the configured figure (an empty window). It encodes a design choice: the flow-lift floor is exclusive, as `MeasuredCop.judge_floor`'s is.
- The ledger's own mutant: `tests/mutation_table.py --pin-killed --scripts tests/features.py` at a275b26db9 printed `PIN KILLED: 4 pinned, 0 left unpinned` and wrote the two `killed_by` pins of a472503fe1 (anchor 017bc704 covers the three sites of the `release` line, each killed; anchor 04683984 the flow-lift bound).

  Both lines are field granularity, not a loss, checked element-wise by group and carry index (base `f8d3342d50`, main and head): R10-REVIEW-DISPATCH-RESIDUE holds 33, 33 and 33 carries; main's six changes since the base (carries 5, 14, 17, 20, 30 and 31, each an inserted `archive/`) are present verbatim at the head at the same indices, except carry 30, whose head text is main's plus one more `archive/`, on `review/3481`, which is this pass's own retarget. - **Bare citations.** `retarget.py` (closure runbook directory, the handoff's prototype inventory) rewrote each citation `closeout.py` step 1 names to its `archive/` tag, applied to `wave-r10-groups.json` and `wave-r9-groups.json` until a dry pass printed no `cited bare` line (4 dry passes). R10-HOTFIX-SELFTEST-SCOPE-RERECORD (part 3): self-test scope re-record from main's run

Main is red on `governance / instrument-self-tests`, step "Refuse a self-test read set the committed table misses". Push run 43660322841 (head 2a257fce08, the newest completed CI run on main when this was cut; runs 43674107312, 43674063124 and 43674024407 were still in progress and carry no `selftest-closures` artifact) prints:

- UNDER-SCOPED step policy-lint-mutants: probes misses dev/programme/round10/state/.gitattributes
- UNDER-SCOPED step dependency-graph-census and prepr: dirs miss dev/programme/round10/state and the tests/mutation_ledger/{killed_by,survivor_triage}/whatif.py directories
- UNDER-SCOPED step temp-or-machine-path: probes miss the two whatif.py/.gitattributes paths
- `selftest_scope check: 116 gated step(s), 4 refusal(s)`

Cause: #3601 added dev/programme/round10/state and #3481 added the whatif.py mutation-ledger directories, which the committed table did not list. Third instance of this repair after #3589 and #3595; the method is #3595's: commit the table the drift step wrote (that run's `selftest-closures` artifact, the committed table unioned with the Linux run's measurement). Never macOS traces.

The committed table is the `selftest-closures` artifact of main push run 43675609284 (head 946eb6d255, artifact id 14146974190), taken as is: it carries the 4 lines above and the 10 `seat_gen` misses that #3491 introduced. See `## Head` for the review block it answers.

## Head

`1617c879d075c732c62c31555eedc45bbed7f38c` merges the authored code head `155470dcd161fec9348cc17027ea66f7287acc6f`.

Code head 155470dcd161fec9348cc17027ea66f7287acc6f, two commits on origin/main 2c69fb3560 (merge base for the table: main at 946eb6d255 per the review).

Fix review blocked 680f34d3d275 (class-open): main push run 43675609284 (head 946eb6d255) prints 14 UNDER-SCOPED lines, 10 of them seat_gen misses my first table lacked. Answer: the table is now that run's `selftest-closures` artifact (id 14146974190) as is. It measures the `seat-gen` step, so the hand-carried `seat-gen` entry is dropped in favour of the measured one (content identical). A newer main run, 43678528951 at 2d0b1c7594, was still in progress with no artifact when this was cut.

## Mutation proof

n/a: no production line changes; the diff is the measured table alone. The table's role is shown both ways under Null control.

## Null control

Replaying `selftest_scope.drift(table, artifact["steps"], workflow_steps(root))` with run 43675609284's artifact as the measurement: against origin/main's table it refuses 14 UNDER-SCOPED lines (the 4 above plus the 10 `seat_gen` misses; no UNMEASURED line, the run measures `seat-gen`); against the head's table it refuses 0 with 0 notes. The artifact holds the table, not the raw traces, so `check --traces` cannot be run here.

## Figures

- Drift refusals, origin/main table: 14. Head table: 0 (notes 0). Same replay, same artifact.
- Head table against the previous head's: 18 lines added, 0 removed; against origin/main's table nothing removed or changed (list compare).

- `python3 -I tools/ci/selftest_scope.py static` at the head: `117 gated step(s), 0 problem(s)`.
- Scope: the table is a gate file, so CI runs FULL.

## Red checks
